primary_question: Can the full process confirm baseline authority with minimal work and stop before conditional investigation?
precommitted_stop_conditions: changed requirements file installed by the owning test path
ordinary and regression pytest responsibilities passed
official upstream drop-in bug-fix status confirmed
no contradictory or missing decision-critical evidence

stop_decision.reason: All precommitted authority conditions passed and no open decision-relevant question remained.

material_value_added_beyond_baseline.summary: The full process confirmed that passing CI had relevant command authority; it added no material action or decision-support value beyond that confirmation.

measurement_limitations: Operation and evidence counts are coarse burden proxies, not elapsed human effort.
Connector retrieval latency and candidate screening are not equivalent to future automated runtime cost.
This one case cannot establish a universal stopping threshold.
The exact cost advantage must be tested across further simple and ambiguous cases.
